title: The House Remembers
phase: visual direction proposal; no runtime integration

machine_alternative.name: v2 clustered pixels
machine_alternative.construction: direct integer raster; no source-image resampling

cards.name: PATTERN RECOGNITION
cards.inspection: Separated matching symbols count as a pair.

cards.name: BOOK
cards.inspection: Adds the Book joker to the reels; the existing Book payout cut remains.

cards.name: HALLUCINATION
cards.inspection: Promotes visible pairs to triples at 30% of that payout. Natural triples and Book wins keep their existing payouts.

cards.name: SMART SAVING
cards.inspection: Keeps the existing increased share of run Lucidity on flatline.

cards.name: REWARD + I
cards.inspection: Choose one symbol for the existing tier I reward amplification.

cards.name: REWARD + II
cards.inspection: Choose one symbol for the existing tier II reward amplification.

cards.name: REWARD + III
cards.inspection: Choose one symbol for the existing tier III reward amplification.

cards.name: JOKER
cards.inspection: After the first three-flatline strike, the dealer can provide the existing helpful power assists.

cards.name: COMBO
cards.inspection: Successive paying results add 5% per streak step, up to 45%. A miss opens the existing rescue window.

cards.name: GLITCH
cards.inspection: Dealer countdown advances three steps per spin at every gauge tier.

cards.name: TUNNEL VISION
cards.inspection: Hides the third reel and increases rewards by 50%.

cards.name: IS IT CHEATING?
cards.inspection: A solo visible symbol counts as a pair; all pair payouts use x0.6.

cards.name: ADRENALINE
cards.inspection: Power restore threshold is 18 Lucidity, with lamps at 6, 12, and 18.

cards.name: PASSIVE GAIN
cards.inspection: Gains 10 run Lucidity on every spin, including misses.

cards.name: REROLL
cards.inspection: Reroll one revealed reel.

cards.name: SHIFT
cards.inspection: Step one revealed reel along the symbol cycle.

cards.name: LOCK
cards.inspection: Lock one reel through upcoming spins.

cards.name: REWIND
cards.inspection: Restore the previous spin state and recover 1-3 eligible other power chips. Earned score and Lucidity remain.

cards.name: HEART
cards.inspection: A free matching heart triple restores 1, 2, or 3 spins with equal odds and advances the gauge.

cards.name: CHEAT
cards.inspection: Replace one selected revealed reel with a symbol from the existing chooser.

cards.name: SWAP
cards.inspection: Drag a visible symbol to another reel and swap it with that reel centre.
